description: Mutants of the trace Module and the Base trace facade (docs/architecture/target/v2/trace-declaration.zh-Hant.md; Design Invariants in target/v2/trace.zh-Hant.md). Each mutant replaces one exact text; killed only when the run fails and its output matches expect.

mutants.what: D2: a span ended by an exception unwinding it is reported as ended normally
mutants.cases: trace facade: a span ended by an exception unwinding it*
mutants.expect: ERROR: CHECK\( installed\.log\.events == std::vector<std::string>\{"begin kernel Main ", "end 1 exception"\} \)

mutants.what: D2: the unwinding count is not taken at Begin, so a span begun during an unwinding is reported as ended by it
mutants.cases: trace facade: a span begun and ended inside a destructor*
mutants.expect: D2: only an unwinding that started after Begin marks the span

mutants.what: D2: a span ends at whatever receiver is installed now instead of the one it began with
mutants.replace: if (receiver_ != nullptr) if (const TraceReceiver* now = Detail::traceReceiver.load()) now->end(token_, std::uncaught_exceptions() > exceptions_);
mutants.cases: trace facade: a span ends at the receiver it began with*
mutants.expect: ERROR: CHECK\( installed\.log\.events == std::vector<std::string>\{"begin kernel Main ", "end 1"\} \)

mutants.what: D2: a second Begin starts the span again (two begins, one end)
mutants.expect: D2: one span, one begin and one end
